ref_summary: Mozilla Thunderbird is a cross-platform email client that allows users to manage multiple email accounts and download messages to a local computer. It supports importing mail folders and address books from services like Gmail, Yahoo, and Eudora. When using POP3, multiple accounts can be combined into a single inbox, and messages can be sorted by criteria such as date, priority, or custom labels. On Ubuntu Linux, Thunderbird can be installed via the Ubuntu Software Center and launched by searching for the application in Dash Home. The interface features a main menu with shortcuts for retrieving mail, composing messages, and opening the address book. It is divided into two panels: the left displays account folders, while the right offers advanced features and account options. To use Thunderbird with external services, POP3 must be enabled, which in Gmail is done under Settings in the Forwarding and POP/IMAP tab before saving changes.

ref_summary: Peer review and document tracking in LibreOffice Writer allow multiple contributors to add, modify, or delete text while clearly showing all revisions in the same file. To enable revision tracking, navigate to Edit, select Changes, and enable the Record option, ensuring that the Show option is also active. When text is inserted, it appears in a distinct color, and hovering over it displays the reviewer's name along with the timestamp of the edit. This name is drawn from the user details entered when LibreOffice was installed. Deleting text does not remove it immediately; instead, it marks the content for deletion and identifies who flagged it. LibreOffice Writer visually differentiates revisions by assigning unique colors to edits made by different reviewers. Hovering over any altered text identifies who performed the modification. Multiple users can thus collaborate, review each other's additions and removals across shared documents, and accept or reject edits before finalizing the document.
fact: To activate change tracking, go to Edit, select Changes, and choose the Record option.

ref_summary: In LibreOffice Impress, slide shows display presentations on full screens or projectors and cannot be edited during the show. Slide transitions are visual effects applied when moving from one slide to another. Within the Slide Sorter tab, users can view all slides and easily rearrange their order by dragging and dropping them.
